description: Na₃Li₃Sc₂F₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic Ia̅3d space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. There are four shorter (2.44 Å) and four longer (2.61 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Li is bonded to four equivalent F atoms to form LiF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. All Li-F bond lengths are 1.89 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form ScF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₄ tetrahedra. All Sc-F bond lengths are 2.04 Å. F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one Sc atom.
